# Demo data (all synthetic, generated by `seed/generate_seed.py` with a fixed random seed)

Postgres database `demo` (separate from n8n's own `n8n` database). Created on first boot by
`docker/postgres/init/` (creates db, runs `seed/schema.sql` then `seed/seed.sql`). Re-seed with
`bash scripts/reseed.sh` (drops and recreates the demo db only).

## Tables (public schema)

| table | key columns | rows | used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| customers | id, external_id, name, email (@lab.local), phone, company, country, city, segment(smb/mid/enterprise), created_at | 60 | T01 B01 A05 R01 |
| products | id, sku, name, category, price, currency, stock, updated_at | 40 | D01 D04 R01 |
| orders | id, order_number, customer_id, status(pending/paid/shipped/cancelled/refunded), total, currency, ordered_at, shipped_at | 200 | T02 R01 M04 |
| order_items | id, order_id, product_id, qty, unit_price | ~420 | R01 |
| employees | id, employee_no, full_name, full_name_ar, department, department_ar, title, email, hired_at | 25 | R03 B04 |
| attendance | id, employee_id, work_date, check_in, check_out, status(present/late/absent/leave) | ~300 | R03 R02 |
| tickets | id, ticket_no, customer_id, channel(email/form/chat/telegram), subject, body, category, priority, status(open/triaged/in_progress/resolved/closed), assigned_to, sla_due_at, created_at, resolved_at | 80 | A02 B04 T05 T07 |
| leads | id, email, name, company, source, score, status(new/contacted/qualified/lost/won), enriched jsonb, created_at, last_contacted_at | 40 | B01 |
| bookings | id, booking_ref, customer_id, service, starts_at, ends_at, status(confirmed/cancelled/completed), reminder_sent_at, created_at | 30 | B02 |
| expenses | id, merchant, amount, currency, spent_at, category, receipt_file, extracted_by, raw_text, created_at | 20 | B03 |
| rate_history | id, base, quote, rate, fetched_at | 30 | M05 |
| uptime_checks | id, target, url, status_code, latency_ms, ok, checked_at | 0 (filled by M01) | M01 |
| uptime_state | target (pk), state(up/warn/down), failures, since, last_alert_at | 3 | M01 |
| webhook_events | id, external_id (unique), source, event_type, payload jsonb, received_at | 0 | T01 M02 P03 |
| sync_state | source (pk), cursor, last_run_at, rows_seen | 2 | T03 D04 |
| products_mirror | id (pk), sku, name, price, stock, content_hash, synced_at | 0 | D04 |
| execution_log | id, execution_id, workflow_id, workflow_name, status, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, error_message, error_node, logged_at | 0 | P01 P08 O05 |
| notifications | id, channel, target, subject, body, severity, sent_at | 0 | M01 M02 M04 P01 |
| content_variants | id, source_title, platform, content, created_at | 0 | A06 |
| tasks | id, source, title, owner, due_date, done, created_at | 0 | A03 |
| documents | id, kind, file_name, storage_key, meta jsonb, created_at | 0 | R01 R02 R03 D05 |

Conventions: all emails end in `@lab.local`; company domains end in `.example.com`; names are generated from
word lists (no real people); Arabic names/departments are generic; money is numeric(10,2); timestamps are `timestamptz`.

## Seed files (`seed/files/`, mounted read-only at `/home/node/.n8n-files/seed/`)

| file | for |
|---|---|
| `customers.csv` (60 rows, 3 deliberately broken rows: bad email, missing name, duplicate) | D01 row-level validation |
| `orders.xlsx` (2 sheets) | D01 XLSX path |
| `invoice-locked.pdf` (table of line items, text-based) | R04 table extraction |
| `receipt-01.png`, `receipt-02.png` (English receipts) | B03 OCR |
| `receipt-ar-01.png` (Arabic receipt, Amiri font) | A04 Arabic OCR |
| `meeting-clip.wav` (~66 s **real speech**, 16 kHz mono: invented 4-person English ops standup) | A03 transcription |
| `article.md` (long article) | A06 repurposing |
| `attendance-week.csv` | R03 report input alternative |

`meeting-clip.wav` is `MEETING_SCRIPT` in `generate_seed.py` (Nadia / Karim / Samir / Leila: stuck orders, the
invoice VAT line, staging paging - with spoken owners, due dates and one decision, so A03 has something to
extract) read out loud by the first **local, free, offline** TTS engine found: Windows SAPI, `espeak-ng`, `piper`
(needs `PIPER_VOICE=...`) or macOS `say`; never a cloud TTS. Output is normalised to 16 kHz mono 16-bit. It is the
only seed artifact that is **not byte-reproducible across machines** (the same engine and voices do reproduce it
byte for byte) - `--check` validates its container and size, not its bytes.
With no engine installed (or `--no-optional-deps`) it falls back to synthetic tones and prints a warning: that
clip does **not** transcribe (Whisper hallucinates over it) and A03 takes its low-confidence lane.

## Webhook payloads (`seed/payloads/`)

`t01-order.json`, `t01-invalid.json`, `github-push.json`, `github-issue.json`, `b01-lead.json`, `b02-booking.json`,
`m02-release.json`, `p03-replay.json` - each workflow's `test/` folder copies or links the relevant one.

## mock-api dataset (`docker/mock-api/db.json`)

Collections mirror the demo db where useful (`products`, `customers`), plus `orders` (120, with `updated_at`),
`events` (300 append-only, incremental ids, types `order.created|order.paid|ticket.opened`), `companies` (domain-keyed),
`posts` (25 blog posts for the RSS feed). Regenerated by `seed/generate_seed.py --mock-api`.
